features: UNIQUE AND STYLISH: the elegant black metal design gives a rustic flair to your décor

description: This Black Metal Traditional Lantern by Elements features an elegant black metal design that gives a rustic flair to any room. Use with any 3 x 3 inch LED pillar candle or wax, tea light candle. You can also place plants, flowers, and more inside. Use to decorate your living room, bedroom, kitchen, and more. Candles not included. Measures 5.3 x 5.3 x 11.8 inches.
